title: Hp500Survey
description: Contract 1 (ingestion of real data), catalog row hp500-survey 1.0.0: one industrial survey of a Metso HP500 secondary cone crusher crushing itabirite iron ore, as accepted by data-pipeline/pipeline/hp500/surveys.py from the table data/examples/hp500-surveys.csv (columns survey, f80_mm, css_mm, feed_tph, power_kw), transcribed verbatim from Table A1 of Rocha, Campos, Silva and Tavares (2024), Minerals 14(9), 919, https://doi.org/10.3390/min14090919, licensed CC BY 4.0. The power is the paper's estimate from the measured electric current. A row that fails a rule is rejected with a reason; the table must hold the ten published surveys, numbered 1 to 10 without a gap (a rule the schema cannot state; the producer test checks it).

f80_mm.description: Measured feed 80 percent passing size, mm.

feed_tph.description: Measured solid feed rate, tonnes per hour.

power_kw.description: Crusher power estimated from the measured current, kW.
